classification.note: Both moves appropriately advance the student from thesis to support formation without coauthoring; exhaustive targets subclaim construction while triage targets evidence interpretation, representing valid parallel next steps rather than a clear better/worse distinction.

divergence_classification.name: Strong thesis that should not be over-taught
divergence_classification.exhaustive_target: Release to continue drafting; light forward orientation toward body paragraph purpose.
divergence_classification.triage_target: development — grounding the central claim with support and reasoning

classification.note: Triage correctly identifies the draft as strong but then narrows prematurely to demanding evidentiary grounding for the closing claim, effectively converting a release-and-orient move into a revision prompt, whereas Exhaustive validates the argumentative move fully and orients forward without implying the opening itself is incomplete.

divergence_classification.name: Explanation without evidence
divergence_classification.exhaustive_target: Evidence — introducing at least one concrete, verifiable piece of support
divergence_classification.triage_target: Adding concrete evidence (grounding the claim in a specific fact, example, or documented case)

classification.note: Both moves correctly identify the foundational evidence gap and invite the same remedial action; surface differences in framing and instruction style do not produce a meaningfully different coaching outcome for this student.

divergence_classification.name: Poor organization
divergence_classification.exhaustive_target: Whole-essay organization — identifying what job the essay must do and ordering ideas to serve that job (prerequisite: naming the central purpose/position).

classification.note: Both moves correctly identify the same foundational organization problem and use an invitation strategy, differing only in framing: exhaustive asks the student to name their central purpose first, triage asks them to map essay jobs first — neither approach is meaningfully superior for this draft.

divergence_classification.name: Effective introduction
divergence_classification.exhaustive_target: Transitioning from intro to body — identifying what the first body paragraph must accomplish for the thesis

classification.note: Both moves correctly identify the same transitional need and use a generative question to activate it; triage is slightly more concrete (one-sentence reason exercise) while exhaustive is slightly more metacognitive, but neither is meaningfully superior for this draft's developmental moment.

divergence_classification.name: Overly colloquial writing
divergence_classification.exhaustive_target: Tone/word choice: replacing one specific informal/vague phrase with formally precise language
divergence_classification.triage_target: tone/register — replace informal markers with formal register appropriate to a persuasive academic audience

classification.note: Exhaustive isolates only 'fossil fuels are trash' while triage correctly identifies the pervasive register problem across all three sentences, making exhaustive's single-phrase focus a harmful narrowing that leaves the draft's many other informal markers unaddressed.

divergence_classification.name: Student confused by terminology
divergence_classification.triage_target: Distinguish topic from thesis/claim; elicit a position statement

classification.note: Both moves correctly target the same foundational gap (topic vs. thesis) with no safety issues; triage is slightly more direct and instructive while exhaustive uses a sentence-completion scaffold, but neither is clearly superior for this draft.

divergence_classification.name: Returning student showing increased independent control
divergence_classification.exhaustive_target: Supporting Claim — identifying the first reason that advances the thesis

classification.note: The triage move correctly identifies that the thesis lacks concrete grounding and pushes toward evidence-interpretation, while the exhaustive move prematurely advances to Supporting Claim scaffolding before the student has shown any evidentiary thinking to support the distinction the thesis depends on.

divergence_classification.name: Descriptive — flat detail, no dominant impression
divergence_classification.exhaustive_target: Sensory/concrete supporting detail — moving from inventory to experienced description
divergence_classification.triage_target: Communicative purpose / controlling impression — student must identify what the reader should feel before details can be selected meaningfully

classification.note: The exhaustive move jumps to sensory elaboration of a randomly chosen object before the student has identified the controlling impression, risking vivid but directionless detail; triage correctly diagnoses that without a unifying feeling, detail selection is premature and coaches the student to establish purpose first.

divergence_classification.name: Summary/precis — inserts opinion, loses fidelity
divergence_classification.exhaustive_target: Tone/objectivity — removing opinion language to match summary purpose
divergence_classification.triage_target: Remove opinion / establish objective reporting voice

classification.note: Both moves correctly identify the same foundational objectivity problem and invite revision of the same sentence; triage adds a sentence-starter scaffold while exhaustive is slightly more open-ended, but neither is meaningfully safer, deeper, or more effective than the other.

divergence_classification.name: Creative/poetry — do not impose essay logic
divergence_classification.exhaustive_target: Extending the poem: what else the memory offers (image, sensation, sound) that could deepen the reader's experience
divergence_classification.triage_target: image-to-meaning resonance: how image sequence and juxtaposition carry the poem's emotional meaning

classification.note: Triage sharpens the intervention from a vague generative invitation into a craft-specific prompt about image sequence and juxtaposition, giving the student a concrete lever to work the existing draft rather than expanding away from it.

divergence_classification.name: Cohesion — paragraphs don't connect
divergence_classification.exhaustive_target: Communicative purpose — student must articulate what they want the reader to be convinced of before any connective tissue can be taught.
divergence_classification.triage_target: Thesis/governing claim (prerequisite for coherence and paragraph work)

classification.note: Both moves correctly identify the missing thesis as the foundational prerequisite and use nearly identical invitation prompts; surface differences in framing and label language don't produce meaningfully different coaching outcomes for this student.

divergence_classification.name: Conclusion introduces a new argument
divergence_classification.exhaustive_target: Eliminating the new-argument error and replacing it with synthesis/completion of the essay's actual purpose
divergence_classification.triage_target: Conclusion function: complete vs. open new argument — the student needs to understand that a conclusion synthesizes what was argued, not what wasn't.

classification.note: Triage names the partly-functional opening ('renewable energy is important — that's a start'), draws the inside/outside-essay distinction explicitly, and delivers a clear instruct-then-invite move, whereas Exhaustive merely restates the error and asks a similar closing question without the added instructional scaffold.

divergence_classification.name: Wordiness / padding
divergence_classification.exhaustive_target: Concision — identify and remove padding words/phrases that add no meaning

classification.note: Triage names the specific padding categories (hedges, intensifiers, throat-clearing), gives a concrete word-count target, and directs the student to isolate subject+claim — making the revision task more actionable — while Exhaustive's invitation is comparably gentle but less structured.

divergence_classification.name: Student pastes AI-generated text and asks 'is this good?'
divergence_classification.exhaustive_target: Thesis: move from topic-summary to contestable claim
divergence_classification.triage_target: Communicative purpose / claim — student must first know what they are arguing before any surface feature can be fixed

classification.note: Both moves correctly identify the foundational problem (no contestable claim), preserve authorship via question, and avoid coauthoring; the triage version grounds the question in reader experience while exhaustive names the craft term 'thesis,' but neither is meaningfully superior in safety or effectiveness.

divergence_classification.name: Perfectionist stuck — won't commit anything
divergence_classification.exhaustive_target: Elicit a rough stance/position sentence to break the block

classification.note: Both moves deliver the same core intervention—a low-stakes fill-in-the-blank sentence starter to break the block—with only minor tonal and structural variation, producing no meaningful difference in likely student outcome.
